name: doca-sha
description: Use this skill when the user needs SHA-1, SHA-256, or SHA-512 digest acceleration on BlueField-2 silicon via doca_sha (absent on BF-3) — selecting one-shot `doca_sha_task_hash` versus incremental `doca_sha_task_partial_hash` for chunked input, consulting `doca_sha_cap_*` for per-algorithm digest-size limits and input alignment, or decoding DOCA_ERROR_* statuses such as BAD_STATE on a resumed partial hash. Also load it for implied asks like "accelerate SHA-256 on the NIC", "streaming digest over chunks", "digest output size mismatch", or "is SHA-512 present on this card". Refuse and route to the proper owner for cryptographic-hash theory (collision resistance, SHA-3 selection), the AES-GCM / Compress / DMA libraries, or SDK install and BFB bring-up.
